A '''diamond sword''' is the [[Diamond equipment|diamond]] [[Weapons#Sword|sword]], crafted from two [[diamond]]s and a stick. It is the base for the [[Electrum Sword|electrum sword]], [[adamant sword]] and [[adamant claymore]].

=== Crafting ===

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|7}} damage at an attack speed of 1.6 and has 2500 durability, the strongest sword without an alloy.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[diamond]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one diamond. It is the base for both [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] and [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] upgrades.
